Tests that Runtime.evaluate reports exceptionDetails without crashing when throwing undefined, number, string, object, or Error. Bug 59611.

Running test: testThrowUndefined
throw undefined
{
    exception : {
        type : undefined
    }
    hasStackTrace : true
    text : Uncaught
}

Running test: testThrowNumber
throw 1
{
    exception : {
        description : 1
        type : number
        value : 1
    }
    hasStackTrace : true
    text : Uncaught
}

Running test: testThrowString
throw 'asdf'
{
    exception : {
        type : string
        value : asdf
    }
    hasStackTrace : true
    text : Uncaught
}

Running test: testThrowObject
throw {a:42}
{
    exception : {
        description : Object
        preview : {
            description : Object
            overflow : false
            properties : [
                [0] : {
                    name : a
                    type : number
                    value : 42
                }
            ]
            type : object
        }
        type : object
    }
    hasStackTrace : true
    text : Uncaught
}

Running test: testThrowError
throw new Error('asdf')
{
    exception : {
        description : Error: asdf     at <anonymous>:1:7
        type : object
    }
    hasStackTrace : true
    text : Uncaught
}
